_what_this_is: the discover step's proposals (model call); the confirm step looks each up in the registries

proposals.title: Climate Change 2022: Mitigation of Climate Change – Working Group III Contribution to the Sixth Assessment Report
proposals.why: Definitive IPCC AR6 assessment: CDR is unavoidable to counterbalance residual emissions and reach net-zero CO2 and GHG targets.

proposals.title: Climate Change 2023: Synthesis Report – Sixth Assessment Report
proposals.why: AR6 Synthesis Report: CDR necessary for net-negative CO2; maps near-, mid- and long-term roles alongside deep emission cuts.

proposals.title: The State of Carbon Dioxide Removal 2024 – 2nd Edition
proposals.why: Global independent scientific assessment of current CDR levels, the CDR gap, and progress needed to meet Paris Agreement goals.

proposals.title: The carbon dioxide removal gap
proposals.why: Quantifies the gap between countries' CDR plans and what 1.5 °C scenarios require; shows novel CDR methods are not yet committed to.

proposals.title: Emissions Gap Report 2023: Broken Record – Temperatures hit new highs, yet world fails to cut emissions (again)
proposals.why: Annual UNEP assessment covering CDR potential and risks; finds delaying emission cuts increases future CDR reliance.

proposals.title: Greenhouse Gas Removal
proposals.first_author: Royal Society and Royal Academy of Engineering
proposals.container: Royal Society / Royal Academy of Engineering
proposals.why: Landmark UK government-commissioned assessment of GGR methods, potentials, and deployment scenarios for reaching net zero by 2050.

proposals.title: Negative emissions—Part 1: Research landscape and synthesis
proposals.why: Foundational systematic review synthesising the full landscape of negative emissions technologies and their role in 1.5–2 °C scenarios.

proposals.title: Negative emissions—Part 2: Costs, potentials and side effects
proposals.why: Companion systematic review assessing costs, deployment potentials, and side-effects of each CDR/NET option across climate scenarios.
